note: Voice-over lines. a/b: seconds in voiceover.m4a. at: where the line lands (sec+t: seconds into a screen; mark+dt: a take mark; said: the n-th narrator line of the take; after: seconds after the previous line). text: the caption, as said. caption:false: audio only.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Suppose I'm Rohin, an AP accountant. Every week I check invoices from our staffing agency, Halcyon, by hand.
lines.heard: Suppose I'm Rohin in AP Accountant. Every week I check invoices from our staffing agency, Halcyon, by hand.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Ramp Teach lets Rohin show that check once, so every bill after already arrives checked, with the proof.
lines.heard: Ramp Teach lets Rohin show that check once, so every bill after already arrives checked with the proof.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: So let's say it's close week, so I'm recording myself reviewing this month's Halcyon invoice.
lines.heard: So let's say it's close week, so I'm recording myself reviewing this month's Halcyon invoice.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Every rate on it has to match the rate card in our contract,
lines.heard: Every rate on it has to match the rate card in our contract,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: and nobody should be billed twice for the same week.
lines.heard: and nobody should be billed twice for the same week.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Then I check each person's hours against their approved timecard.
lines.heard: Then I check each person's hours against their approved timecard.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Maya's approved for 40 hours, so billed hours can't go over that.
lines.heard: Maya's approved for 40 hours, so billed hours can't go over that.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Sam's approved for 36.
lines.heard: Sam's is approved for 36.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: If anything's off, I dispute it and ask the agency for a credit memo.
lines.heard: If anything's off, I dispute it and ask the agency for a credit memo.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: When I stop, each thing I said shows up, linked to the step it was about.
lines.heard: When I stop, each thing I said shows up, linked to the step it was about.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Rohin, while you worked, the recorder saved each click with the exact element you hit, and every sentence you said with its timing, matched to the clicks around it.
lines.heard: Rohin, while you worked, the recorder saved each click with the exact element you made and every sentence you said with this timing matched the clicks around it.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Your click shows where the evidence is, and your sentences say the rules.
lines.heard: Your click shows where the evidence is, and your sentences say the rules.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: So now I'm going to send it to Ramp.
lines.heard: So now I'm going to send it to Ramp.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Rohin's recording becomes a workflow, and when the next invoice comes in, an agent runs that workflow in its own browser, bringing back the same evidence.
lines.heard: Rohin's recording becomes a workflow, and when the next invoice comes in, an agent runs that workflow in its own browser, bringing back the same evidence.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Bill Pay is learning my review, one stage at a time.
lines.heard: Bill Pay is learning my review one stage at a time.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Here's what it learned.
lines.heard: Here's what it learned.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Each rule points back to what I said and where I clicked,
lines.heard: Each rule points back to what I said and where I clicked,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: and my recording keeps my words lined up with my clicks.
lines.heard: and my recording keeps my words lined up with my clicks.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Claude reads your recording and writes the workflow: each rule with the words and click that it came from, and where the proof lives.
lines.heard: Claude reads your recording and writes the workflow. Each rule with the words and click that it came from, and that's where the proof lives.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: It learns what to check and where to find it, writing real deterministic math code to spot differences.
lines.heard: It learns what to check and where to find it, writing real deterministic math code to spot differences.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Here it passed its evals, so this is now our active workflow.
lines.heard: Here it passed its evals, so this is now our active workflow.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Just now, a new invoice from Halcyon hit my approval queue,
lines.heard: Just now, a new invoice from Halcyon hit my approval queue,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: so we can see Ramp picks the right workflow and starts its agent.
lines.heard: so we can see Ramp picks the right workflow and starts its agent.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: While it does that, I can watch the agent's own browser right here in the bill,
lines.heard: While it does that, I can watch the agent's own browser right here in the bill,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: and it also pulls each timecard the same way I did.
lines.heard: and it also pulls each timecard the same way I did.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: The run lives under Workflows, with every model turn and tool call,
lines.heard: The run lives under workflows with every model turn and tool call,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: and each step shows its tokens, cost and request ID.
lines.heard: and each step shows its tokens, cost, and request ID.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: So every fact gets reread from its page by plain code.
lines.heard: So every fact gets reread from its page by plain code.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: It found three problems and $3,500 to credit back,
lines.heard: It found three problems and 3 ,500 to credit back,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: and this is where I can dispute it, as the agent never approves or pays anything itself.
lines.heard: and this is where I can dispute it as an agent never approves or pays anything itself.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: The agent gets its own browser, and each turn Claude sees the page as an outline, picks the action, and gets the result.
lines.heard: The agent gets its own browser, and each turn Claude sees the page as an outline, picks the action, and gets the result.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: It only records the facts with the page that they came from, and code turns them into pass or fail.
lines.heard: It only records the fact that the page that they came from encodes turns them into pass or fail.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Claude writes the receipt, and then you make the call.
lines.heard: Claude writes to the receipt, and then you make the call.

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: Next, this is a clean invoice from the same agency,
lines.heard: Next, this is a clean invoice from the same agency,

lines.speaker: rohin
lines.text: and since everything checks out, just one click from me moves it on to payment.
lines.heard: and since everything checks out, just one click from me moves it onto the payment.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: We test the checks against past corrections, the learnings against recordings with known answers, and the whole review end to end.
lines.heard: We test the checks against past corrections, the learnings against recordings with known answers, and the whole review end to end.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Every Claude call is logged with its tokens, its cost, and request ID that we can look up for observability.
lines.heard: Every Claude call is logged with its tokens, its cost, and request ID that we can look up for observability.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Today, this one recording from Rohin can become a tested workflow, with evidence behind every single recommendation.
lines.heard: Today, this one recording from Rohan can become a tested workflow with evidence behind every single recommendation.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: In the future, we see integrations with Teams and Slack to attach evidence from there to receipts as well.
lines.heard: In the future, we see integrations with Teams and Slack to attach evidence from there to receipts as well.

lines.speaker: sahith
lines.text: Thank you.
lines.heard: Thank you.
